children: IREN’s fiscal Q1 revenue rose 66% sequentially to $228 million, led by AI Cloud, up 182% to $200 million. Adjusted EBITDA climbed to $66 million; backlog grew 22% to $20.3 billion.
IREN said Microsoft requested a Horizon 1 network upgrade to support 200 MW for newer AI models. Horizon 2 is commissioning, Horizon 3 GPUs are on site, and Horizon 4 GPUs are expected soon.
After IREN’s results, Goldman Sachs kept Neutral with a $30 target. BTIG maintained Buy, cutting its target to $65 from $80; HC Wainwright cut to $56 from $74, and Cantor Fitzgerald to $47 from $99.
- Macquarie maintained its Outperform rating on IREN Limited (IREN) and lowered its price target to $55 from $90.
Futurum Group CEO Daniel Newman said IREN’s short-term AI deals reach $40 million per megawatt, versus $22 million for long-term contracts, and called its share price disconnected from fundamentals.
